notablePrerequisites: Ocular Halo attached to a creature you control without summoning sickness.
description:
Activate the creature with Ocular Halo attached by tapping it, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
